# chainlaunch_shared_networks (Data Source)

Query networks that have been shared with this Chainlaunch instance.

This data source retrieves shared networks (Fabric or Besu) that have been shared by other connected Chainlaunch instances.
Use optional name filter to narrow down results.

**Important**: This is a Pro-only feature.

**Workflow**:
1. Connect to peer nodes using `chainlaunch_node_invitation` and `chainlaunch_node_accept_invitation`
2. Peers share networks with you using `chainlaunch_network_share`
3. Use this data source to list all shared networks
4. Accept networks using `chainlaunch_shared_network_accept`



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Filter by network name (exact match, case-sensitive)

### Read-Only

- `networks` (Attributes List) List of shared networks matching the filter criteria (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--networks))

<a id="nestedatt--networks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `networks`

Read-Only:

- `connection_id` (Number) ID of the connection used for this share
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the share was created
- `data` (Map of String) Network data as map (contains network configuration, genesis block, name, etc.)
- `id` (String) Unique share ID (use this to accept the share)
- `resource_id` (String) ID of the network resource
- `resource_type` (String) Type of resource (fabric_network or besu_network)
- `shared_by` (String) Description of who shared this network
- `shared_by_node_id` (String) Node ID of who shared this network
- `status` (String) Status of the share (pending, accepted, rejected)
